1937, July
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Blank Page
July 29 Two Women ask for prayers to change attitude of husbands. They want to become Catholics and in each case the husband, a mason, threatens civil divorce,
30 Mrs. L. Livernois - 41 - bronical and kidney trouble - has family depending on her .... fears operation - her husband died when baby was only 4 mo. - now coming to five years old.
Jos. Vern'd Kenninger - Victim of Ohio floods with wife and two boys. Taken to Rec. Hosp'tl - nerveous break .... Wife and mother fears insanity.
Gloria Burch - 11 - an orphan - had rickets when 7 mo. old became fearfully deformed. Drs. said she'd never get well or walk. Now looks healthy and bright after recent operation - Hopes to walk O.K. soon .....
Charles Olofson - 54 - Lutheran - had accident 2 yrs ago. Losing use of arm. It remains quite like paralysed.
Helen Troia - 20 - operation for Apendicitis & tuomers ..... not im- proving.
Mrs. Flo Haig - 44 - groth rectum cancer
Mrs. E. Cullen - 43 - a stroke 3 yrs. in Nov ..... at times dis- couraged
Page 206 July 30
Richard Caloia - lock-jaw last week ...... coming along OK ... Drs. .. wonder .....
Raymond Shee - 14 - operation last January. . .. . don't heal. ...
Phymoth Strikes ...... an
1937, August
Page 207 Aug. 4th Witold Slomka - 19 - looking for employment. Plays violin at con- certs. July 6th left home, wandering away - even to Texas ... . . On July 27 Mother came to Monastery like heart broken-hearted wonder- ing what to think about son. She had not been to confession for 10 yrs. but went to confession that day. To-day she comes with her son who wants to go again to the holy sacraments, has not been since his First Holy Com'n. One night sleeping out in the field, about the time of his Enrollment a huge snake awake'd him by
